notes.title: Update 1.34
notes.notes:
Update 1.34

1) Please to announce that I have finally got around to adding custom keyboard mapping for input.
2) Added 2 new tutorial screens and changed the text on a few to make it easier for newer players.
3) Fixed some layout issues with tutorial screens.
4) Options can be accessed from various tutorial screens now to change keyboard mapping. 
5) Changed a few things on the first 4 stages to make it more engaging.

I am still working on the new Egyptian world and should arrive within the next few months.

notes.title: Halloween Update!
notes.notes:
[b]New Halloween Update![/b]

The addition of 3 new Halloween themed rare cards to the Mythic deck. All 3 cards are only unlock-able by using mythic card tokens within the token management screen. You require 50 of these tokens to unlock each card.

The first card is named "Big Boo". This card uses scare tactics to frighten your enemy, removing 20 HP from your opponent, there are always consequences however and you will also take a 5 HP hit. This rare card will costs 9 manna to play and has a moderately high attack value of 8 and defence value of 7.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33710107/1d8fafab05583399c25ccb458e1fc5428088aef9.png[/img]

The second is a magic card called "Haunted", requires a high manna of 12 but has the ability to increase your HP by a useful 25 points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33710107/ac48a1ea5e5fbc066842996c8e852a5005bca8b1.png[/img]

Lastly is "Bewitched", also a magic card with an even higher manna requirement of 14, the card buffs all your defense counters by 5.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33710107/69dd60655abf3f6dee3dccc830c1d5c20577c4d3.png[/img]

Do you see yourself as a hero light bearer?, then take up the challenge against darkness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33710107/3dfab63a09797bfce123e736300c2c01342a55fe.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Temple Setis Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33710107/672dab59f0e56495e55fdae7b5bf8fdf2c7a8d96.jpg[/img]

I just wanted to do a little tease to all the brave light bearers out there, to let them know what will be coming their way shortly. I am working on the 2.0 update which brings a new Egyptian world called Temple Setis to the map. The world will be unlocked to all players who reach 1 million score.

The play style for the physics platform stages will be different yet again in this new world. Temple floors slope steeply into the ground causing the Fire Orb to reach high speeds, careful you may lose sight of the orb so slowing it  down by any means will be crucial to manage the orb. Slowing it down is one thing but increasing momentum again to move over further objects is another challenge.

The free update will include a number of Egyptian themed physics and card boss stages for your enjoyment or frustration :)

notes.title: New Update Ver 1.16
notes.notes:
Second round of the recently planned update cycle. Majority of these changes will help you understand the game better.

1) Added a confirmation popup when clicking the New Game button.

2) Added a video tutorial button on the card guide screen to view the card video tutorial outside from playing the first card battle.

3) Added popup text indicating when you have already gained 1 manna in a turn when you try to play an additional manna card or sacrifice a playing card for manna.

4) Various tutorial text additions and improvements.

5) Updated downloadable manual with new card images.

We have had impressive high scores set by a single player, even beating some of the developers scores, well done to them.

Don't forget about the new Halloween rare unlock-able cards coming towards the end of the month.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33710107/4e256b452462004c04b58ae794bfaccc41a4f943.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Update Ver 1.15
notes.notes:
Update 1.15

Some renewed development time is being spent on the game and this is the very first of those updates and improvements. I hope you will get some enjoyment out of the updates going forward.

1) Upgraded the menu system with various animation improvements.

2) I have additionally added 4 new cards to the Mythic Deck, 3 uncommon cards and 1 common card. All cards are added immediately to your deck and none need to be collected or token unlocked. Some additional cards will arrive at the end of the month for Halloween which can only be unlocked via the Mythic Card token.

The Samurai card is a medium common playing card, using 6 manna to play. Being a typical blade warrior it produces a descent attack of 7, but a lower defence value of 4. The cards most useful ability is to take 3 points off the opponents inflated attack counters for both lanes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33710107/47572b0231ddd15582b3891aeac07a438baa630a.png[/img]

The Orcra is a uncommon playing card, 8 manna needed to play, it has a moderate defence of 5 and decent attack value of 7. Its ability like any tough and vicious Orc descendent, will remove 5 HP from their opponent. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33710107/5e1ab79e3c641fb26fe55cad77c29b84bfe2dd43.png[/img]

Another uncommon card, In mythology Pegasus has always been a helpful creature and deals the player 2 new cards from the deck, really useful if your hand stands empty in the later rounds. Requires high manna of 10, has a very low attack ability but its saving grace is its very high defence value.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33710107/906a5f902aaa86dc3fe48548ed6d215a85248c8c.png[/img]

The Wizard card is a magic uncommon card that requires a very high manna value of 14, the good thing is its ability to provide 4 new cards to your hand, which may very well turn the tables on your opponent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33710107/67468dd0d9f909eb66f00277bd73857531e726ca.png[/img]
